## Player-facing change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Include screenshots or a short recording for interface or battle changes.

- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass.
- [ ] Saved games and promised teammate moves remain compatible, or a deliberate migration is documented.
- [ ] Affected controls work with keyboard, touch, and narrow screens.
- [ ] Affected battles work with full/reduced/off motion, sound controls, and replay.
- [ ] New assets and dependencies include their source and required license notices.

Mark items not applicable when the change does not affect them.

Definitions: migration = converting older saved data to a new format; dependency = another package used by the project.
